caption: The drawing consists of five objects arranged on a beige background. At the upper left is a detailed illustration of a round pocket watch with a light gray-blue case, white dial, black numerals, and black hands; the dial reads "TRENTON WATCH COMPANY" and features a separate sub-dial for seconds above the 6 o'clock mark. To its immediate right, at the top center, is a minimally detailed black line drawing of the pocket watch's shape and side profile, labeled "EXACT SIZE." Further to the right, at the upper right corner, is a circular view of the back of the pocket watch, displaying ornate, symmetrical engravings of flowers, leaves, scrolls, and an oval centerpiece, all shaded in pale blue and gray tones. At the bottom center is a technical drawing of the internal mechanism of the watch, showing gears and parts in gray, blue, gold, and black, with some metallic texture. The text "TRENTON WATCH CO." and "U.S.A." appear on the movement. The drawing uses primarily shades of gray, blue, gold, and black, with a focus on line work and shading to indicate form and texture.
title: Watch, Dial and Frame
